_note: Home page banner slider. Slide order here is the order on screen. Two fields drive the button: categoryId decides WHETHER there is one and which Products filter it lands on (must match a categoryId in categories.json; "" means no button), and cta is its label — leave cta empty and it falls back to "More Details" / "المزيد من التفاصيل" in whichever language is active. Editable in the Admin Dashboard > Home Banner tab; anything saved there is layered over this file, per item, in localStorage.
